tasks.title: Factors That Change Ocean Salinity
paras: If the salinity of ocean waters is analyzed, it is found to vary only slightly from place to place. Nevertheless, some of these small changes are important. There are three basic processes that cause a change in oceanic salinity. One of these is the subtraction of water from the ocean by means of evaporation--conversion of liquid water to water vapor. In this manner, the salinity is increased, since the salts stay behind. If this is carried to the extreme, of course, white crystals of salt would be left behind.

The opposite of evaporation is precipitation, such as rain, by which water is added to the ocean. Here the ocean is being diluted so that the salinity is decreased. This may occur in areas of high rainfall or in coastal regions where rivers flow into the ocean. Thus, salinity may be increased by the subtraction of water by evaporation or decreased by the addition of freshwater by precipitation or runoff.

Normally, in tropical regions where the sun is very strong, the ocean salinity is somewhat higher than it is in other parts of the world where there is not as much evaporation. Similarly, in coastal regions where rivers dilute the sea, salinity is somewhat lower than in other oceanic areas.

A third process by which salinity may be altered is associated with the formation and melting of sea ice. When seawater is frozen, the dissolved materials are left behind. In this manner, seawater directly beneath freshly formed sea ice has a higher salinity than it did before the ice appeared. Of course, when this ice melts, it will tend to decrease the salinity of the surrounding water.

questions.stem: What does the passage mainly discuss?

options.B: The bodies of water of the world
options.C: The many forms of ocean life

questions.analysis: 题型：主旨题 原文定位：第一段，首段明确主题："There are three basic processes that cause a change in oceanic salinity." 全文围绕盐度变化的三大机制（蒸发、降水/径流、海冰）展开，未涉及盐的成分（A）、水体分布（B）或海洋生物（C）。

questions.stem: According to the passage, the ocean generally has more salt in
questions.analysis: 题型：细节题 原文定位：第三段直接说明："in tropical regions where the sun is very strong, the ocean salinity is somewhat higher..." 热带地区因蒸发强烈导致盐分浓缩（对应第一段蒸发机制）。 选项分析： A 沿海地区：因河流稀释盐度较低（第三段）； C 多雨区：降水稀释盐度（第二段）； D 湍流区：未提及。

questions.stem: All of the following are processes that decrease salinity EXCEPT
questions.analysis: 题型：细节题 原文定位：第一段、第二段、第四段 选项分析： 选项 盐度变化 原文依据 A 蒸发 ↑ 增加 第一段："salinity is increased by evaporation" B 降水 ↓ 降低 第二段："precipitation... salinity is decreased" C 径流 ↓ 降低 第二段："runoff... decrease salinity" D 融冰 ↓ 降低 第四段："melting... decrease salinity" 唯一例外：蒸发（A）是唯一增加盐度的过程。

questions.stem: Which of the following statements about the salinity of a body of water can best be inferred from the

options.A: The temperature of the water is the most important factor.
options.B: The speed with which water moves is directly related to the amount of salt
options.C: Ocean salinity has little effect on sea life
options.D: Various factors combine to cause variations in the salt content of water

questions.analysis: 题型：推断题 原文定位： 首段总述三大过程共同影响盐度； 第二段对比蒸发与降水的相反作用； 第三段以热带与沿海为例说明区域差异； 第四段补充海冰的双向影响（形成↑盐度，融化↓盐度）。 选项分析： A 水温最关键：未提及温度的核心性； B 水流速度相关：无文本支持； C 盐度不影响海洋生物：超出讨论范围。

questions.stem: The word "altered" is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 题型：词汇题 原文定位：第四段 "When seawater is frozen, the dissolved materials are left behind... higher salinity... When ice melts, decrease salinity." 海冰形成和融化导致盐度双向变化，因此"altered"指动态调整，对应changed。 选项分析： A determined（决定）：未体现动态过程； C accumulated（积累）：与盐度升降矛盾； D needed（需要）：语义不符。
